cohort: 432 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancy and intact amniotic membranes at or beyond 37 gestational weeks scheduled for induction of labour by Foley catheter
finding: Oxytocin induction and early epidural analgesia were associated with caesarean delivery, while gestational diabetes and early epidural analgesia were associated with infectious morbidity.
mod_finding: Oxytocin induction and early epidural analgesia were associated with caesarean delivery.
